sections.project_context:
<project_context>
Project-specific instructions and guidelines:

<project_instructions path="/root/.pi/agent/AGENTS.md">
# Global Agent Rules

## Long-running commands must run in the background

Any command expected to run longer than 30 seconds (builds, full test suites,
dev servers, downloads, benchmarks, watch loops) must use bg_run instead of
bash. The bg_run name parameter must be a short human-readable label of
2-6 words. Return immediately after launching and continue the conversation;
do not poll or wait.

## Background tasks must not be started inside one-shot subagents

bg_run is only valid in long-lived sessions (interactive TUI or pi-web).
Background tasks are killed when the owning process exits, and one-shot
subagent processes (pi --mode json -p --no-session) exit right after their
final message, so any bg_run task they start is silently killed and its
notification has no session to wake. Inside a subagent, run long commands in
the foreground and deliver the complete result synchronously; if the parent
session needs the work backgrounded, the parent should launch bg_run itself.

</project_instructions>
</project_context>
